hypothesis: Within-root terminal-margin targets over post-action semantic pair features improve disjoint calibration root Top-1 over static order and state-value v2.
single_variable: Learning target changed from state winner classification to within-root action preference; representation and protocol otherwise frozen.
notes: No Top-1 or regret gain. The production action has the same sole semantic delta (inventoryTotal +3) but terminal-margin effects of +76 in development and -10 in calibration, proving the linear absolute post-state representation cannot express the needed context-dependent sign. An earlier all-deterministic collection was discarded after exceeding the 700-command bound; no partial labels were retained.

hypothesis: Expanding predeclared disjoint roots while holding the model fixed will determine whether iteration 1's action-delta conflict is stable.
single_variable: Development and calibration seed count increased from one to four per split; representation, candidate cap, continuation policy, learner and metrics remained fixed.
notes: All 12+12 roots and 64 candidates completed under one ruleset. Every exact calibration action-delta pattern has both positive and negative terminal labels; all tested models preserve static choices. The next experiment must measure label stability across a small continuation-policy population before adding action-context interactions.

hypothesis: A fixed production root has a stable terminal-optimal action under a small paired official-built-in continuation seed population.
single_variable: Continuation sampling increased from one baseline seed stream to three paired seed streams on four frozen production roots; roots, candidates, acting policy, engine and command bound stayed fixed.
notes: Sample zero reproduced all iteration-2 terminal margins. Every root's preferred candidate flipped under another continuation. The three-sample mean retained the baseline sign on these selected roots but is not a convergence claim. Single-continuation terminal regret is unsuitable as a supervised label; next use paired sequential sampling with uncertainty and abstention.

hypothesis: A predeclared paired sequential decision rule will abstain instead of forcing labels from the noisy three-sample production puncture.
single_variable: Replaced naive sample-mean sign with exact paired terminal-rank sign tests at stages 3/7/15 using alpha spending and per-stage Bonferroni correction; outcomes were unchanged.
notes: All roots correctly request seven samples. Terminal rank is primary; noisy cash means are diagnostic only. This establishes fail-closed semantics before additional simulation spend.

hypothesis: Seven paired continuations will select only production roots with stable terminal-rank evidence and defer all others.
single_variable: Available paired samples increased from three to seven by computing only indices 3-6; roots, candidates, policy, estimator and alpha spending remained fixed.
notes: The resume path preserved all prior values and atomically appended four samples per candidate. No root clears alpha 0.02. One mean cash advantage reversed from -215.67 to +10, reinforcing that cash diagnostics cannot force a label.

hypothesis: At the frozen fifteen-sample maximum, only production roots with stable paired terminal-rank evidence receive labels and every other root becomes an explicit abstention.
single_variable: Available paired samples increased from seven to fifteen by computing only indices 7-14; roots, candidates, policy, estimator and alpha spending remained fixed.
notes: All roots exhausted the predeclared maximum without terminal-rank significance. Rank ties occur in 4-10 of 15 pairs per root. These production roots are excluded from supervised labels under continuation population v1; the maximum will not be enlarged post hoc.

hypothesis: The same three-sample paired gate will identify any stable hiring or marketing roots before larger continuation spend.
single_variable: Decision family changed from production to two frozen hiring and two frozen marketing roots; sample count, continuation population, candidates and estimator stayed fixed.
notes: Sample zero and candidate reconstruction match iteration 2. Formal selection is 0/4. Stages 3 and 7 cannot mathematically select among three candidates after Bonferroni correction, so the estimator now reports reachability and skips to 15. Further weak-built-in sampling is deferred until opponent population v1 is defined.

hypothesis: A frozen multi-archetype opponent population can expose reproducible sampling and explicit public-history sensitivity without accepting hidden state.
single_variable: Continuation opponent representation changed from one official-built-in seed stream to a versioned four-archetype population contract; no action-regret labels or search policy changed.
notes: The contract separates observed/derived/believed provenance, binds updates to a public-history digest and updater id, and records model id/confidence/sample count. External policies see legal views only; official AI delegates to the environment adapter. Hand-set priors are explicitly uncalibrated and cannot yet drive rollout labels or search.

hypothesis: Public event-count prefixes identify frozen opponent policies on disjoint official-engine games while rejecting unmodelled human play as OOD.
single_variable: Added a Laplace-smoothed public-event histogram likelihood model over the frozen population; policies, 160-command horizon, six development and six calibration seeds and promotion holdout stayed fixed.
notes: All 12 official-engine prefixes and 48 seat samples passed public-only/balance/split gates. Known-policy Top-1 missed the frozen gate; deterministic and random styles were confused. Human OOD passed, but remaining predictions were overconfident and collapsed toward official built-in. Histogram beliefs stay disconnected; next hold protocol/model fixed and add bounded public temporal/context features.

hypothesis: Adjacent public event transitions improve frozen-policy identification without weakening human OOD detection.
single_variable: Feature representation added adjacent within-seat public event transitions; policies, seeds, seat rotations, 160-command horizon, likelihood model, smoothing, OOD method and gates remained identical to iteration 9.
notes: V2 exactly reproduces v1 unigram counts and adds only public order. Both selection gates pass, but two seeded-random samples are confidently misclassified as safe-first and all 24 samples occupy the highest confidence bin. Promote only to independent temperature/abstention calibration on new validation seeds; live beliefs and search remain disconnected.

hypothesis: A scalar temperature and frozen confidence abstention threshold calibrate temporal opponent beliefs on unseen official-engine seeds.
single_variable: Added scalar temperature and confidence abstention fitted on the consumed calibration split; temporal features, likelihood model, policies, horizon and OOD method stayed fixed, with six new validation seeds.
notes: Temperature calibration generalized and four of five gates passed, but coverage missed by one sample. The global NLL threshold rejected six correctly classified style-specific samples. The validation block is consumed; do not relax the gate. Next fit class-conditional OOD thresholds on old calibration data and evaluate once on fresh seeds.

hypothesis: Predicted-class-conditional NLL thresholds recover valid belief coverage without reducing accepted accuracy.
single_variable: Replaced one global OOD NLL threshold with 95th-percentile thresholds by predicted model fitted on the old calibration rows; temperature, confidence threshold, temporal features, policies, horizon and gates remained frozen, with six new validation seeds.
notes: Class-conditional OOD fixed the prior coverage failure and every accepted prediction was correct, but frozen temperature 3 worsened log loss on the second independent block. Do not select temperature 1 post hoc. Next predeclare block-robust calibration using consumed blocks as development and evaluate once on multiple fresh blocks; beliefs remain disconnected.

hypothesis: Worst-block-constrained calibration generalizes across multiple fresh seed blocks without aggregate masking.
single_variable: Replaced single-block scalar-temperature fitting with a deterministic three-consumed-block worst-case calibration rule; temporal model, predicted-class OOD thresholds, four policies, horizon and per-block gates remained fixed, then 18 fresh games were partitioned into three predeclared blocks.
notes: All three fresh blocks passed independently; aggregate performance was not used to rescue a subgroup. Freeze calibration v5 and advance only to information-set consistency. Belief-driven search and the promotion holdout remain disabled.

hypothesis: A paired-world audit can detect strategy fusion without persisting private simulator state.
single_variable: Added an independent information-set consistency audit primitive; no planner, evaluator, belief calibration or policy behavior changed.
notes: The harness rejects unequal public information sets and illegal candidates, reuses identical belief samples across worlds, and reports ids/counts only. P3.3e remains open until official-engine paired fixtures and the actual belief-aware planner pass.

hypothesis: The current official rollout is invariant to real hidden reserve-card submission envelopes that share one public information set.
single_variable: Replaced synthetic trusted worlds with an official-engine reserve-card simultaneous fixture; planner, evaluator, belief population, candidates and zero-TV gate remained unchanged.
notes: Official legal transitions produced different private move envelopes with identical public state. The sanitized report is byte-reproducible after normalizing display-only history timestamps. P3.3e remains open for another authentic hidden boundary and the belief-aware planner.

hypothesis: The current official rollout is invariant to hidden opponent restructuring submissions that change next-working-day capabilities but share one public information set.
single_variable: Added a second official-engine paired fixture at restructuring; planner, evaluator, belief population, candidates and zero-TV gate remained unchanged.
notes: Corrected the prior working-day-boundary assumption because base working day is sequential. Official restructuring worlds used different active-vs-beach opponent assignments. The first reproduction check exposed wall-clock-sorted display history; a frozen fixture clock made the report byte-reproducible. P3.3e remains open until the actual belief-sampled planner passes.

hypothesis: Explicit switching cost, confidence, hysteresis and cooldown can capture genuine opportunities without plan tunneling or oscillation.
single_variable: Added a deterministic public-evidence plan-health arbiter and connected its selected relation to bounded candidate priority; official legality, evaluator, opponent belief, rollout and promotion holdout remained unchanged.
notes: Genuine expiry deviates temporarily; destructive bait continues; reusable failure repairs; infeasible alternatives pivot or abandon. Tactical deviation preserves the plan graph, and pivot/abandon require explicit replacement. This promotes the control contract only; P4 must calibrate values and prove terminal league lift.

hypothesis: A bounded belief-sampled scenario beam can traverse multiple actor decisions and fresh simultaneous phases while preserving information-set consistency and legal fallback.
single_variable: Added the scenario-beam planner contract and production adapter; frozen evaluator, candidate generator, opponent population, official engine and promotion holdout remained unchanged.
notes: The official smoke crossed restructuring and selected skip over turn-1 hire because the current cutoff evaluator preferred 39 over 35.4. Future simultaneous actor commitments are frozen across matched belief samples to prevent strategy fusion. Proceed to one-/three-second development leagues and horizon sensitivity; do not integrate into live play.

hypothesis: The actual ScenarioBeam production adapter safely returns an information-set-consistent policy on official live simultaneous roots with different trusted hidden submissions.
single_variable: Replaced the previously audited bounded-rollout recommendation with ScenarioBeam v1 on both frozen official paired-world fixtures; engine, static candidates, opponent population, beliefs and zero-TV gate remained unchanged.
notes: ScenarioBeam safely declines live simultaneous roots before cloning and returns the same static public candidate. P3.3e closes for this planner version only; any future hidden-boundary search specialist must pass independently. Playing strength remains unpromoted.

hypothesis: A single ScenarioBeam intervention under declared one-second or three-second budgets can improve terminal play over the same static policy.
single_variable: Allowed exactly one first eligible working-day ScenarioBeam intervention; all subsequent agent decisions, official opponent, two development seeds and paired seats remained common across arms.
notes: One-second Beam safely fell back to hire. Three-second Beam completed and changed hire to skip in every paired game, causing 0/4 wins versus static 4/4. Stop league expansion; diagnose horizon/leaf ranking and add a safety gate before retesting.

hypothesis: The harmful skip choice is an intermediate-horizon alias where hiring cost is visible before delayed engine revenue.
single_variable: Swept only maxOwnDepth from 1 through 8 on the identical official root, candidates, opponent belief and matched sample seeds; deadline and transition caps were non-binding.
notes: Fixed deeper search is not a safe or budget-compliant repair. Next change one variable: a shallow/deep recommendation-agreement gate before any search override.
